title: TryOnReward: Learning Foveated Consistency for Reinforcement Fine-Tuning of Virtual Try-On
abstract: arXiv:2609.13259v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Virtual Try-On (VTON) aims to dress a person with the reference garment, producing visually reasonable results aligned with human preferences. Turning this preference-oriented goal into an actionable objective relies on a scoring function aligned with human taste. However, classic fidelity metrics exhibit weak correlation with human judgments, and generic VLMs fail to provide the discriminative granularity demanded by try-on quality evaluation, which hinges on faithfully preserving garment and person details. This shortcoming is further exacerbated in the reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) optimization and leads to severe reward hacking. To this end, we present TryOnReward, a fine-grained reward model tailored for VTON. Built on a vision-language backbone, it adopts a foveation calibration objective that grounds each quality dimension in the relevant region to avoid global shortcut learning. translated_title: TryOnReward：面向虚拟试穿强化微调的注视一致性学习
translated_abstract: 虚拟试穿（Virtual Try-On, VTON）旨在为人物穿上参考服装，生成视觉上合理且符合人类偏好的结果。要将这一以偏好为导向的目标转化为可执行的优化目标，需要一个与人类审美对齐的评分函数。然而，经典的保真度指标与人类判断的相关性较弱，而通用的视觉语言模型（VLM）无法提供试穿质量评估所需的判别粒度——这种评估的关键在于忠实保留服装和人物细节。这一缺陷在强化微调（RFT）优化中进一步加剧，并导致严重的奖励劫持（reward hacking）问题。为此，我们提出了TryOnReward，一个专为VTON量身定制的细粒度奖励模型。该模型构建于视觉语言骨干之上，采用注视校准目标，将每个质量维度锚定在相关区域上，从而避免全局捷径学习。同时，TryOnReward联合优化成对……
tldr: 提出了TryOnReward——一个基于视觉语言骨干并采用注视校准目标的细粒度奖励模型，通过将每个质量维度锚定到相关区域来避免全局捷径学习，为虚拟试穿的强化微调提供与人类偏好对齐的奖励信号并缓解奖励劫持问题。
en_tdlr: TryOnReward is a fine-grained reward model for virtual try-on, built on a vision-language backbone with a foveation calibration objective that grounds each quality dimension in relevant regions, thereby providing human-aligned rewards for reinforcement fine-tuning and mitigating reward hacking.
